Text, input, variable, file and scripting steps run in the app (evaluate); Save File writes to the app's Saved folder. Blocks are edited as rows, not as nested cards. Choose from Menu is not done. Not yet checked on the lab machine.

features.note: The shortcut model stores one automation per shortcut, an app opening or the charge falling below a level, in the list file; due returns the shortcuts that an app opening or a battery change starts, tested headless. features.note: Each shortcut has its own menu key, 1 to 9 (Control and Command with the digit), chosen with the Menu Key row in the editor (set_key, springboard/src/shortcuts.rs:722; the first four shortcuts of a first launch hold keys 1 to 4); the app's Shortcuts menu lists every shortcut with its key and runs it while the app is in front (run_key, menus.rs:24).
